review_candidates.title: Digital Monetization & Ad Ops Manager
review_candidates.location: Qesm El Sheikh Zaid, Al Jizah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: ABOUT THR ROLE: We are seeking a Digital Monetization & Ad Ops Manager to be responsible for the end-to-end operational execution and of monetization across all digital channels, including web display and video, mobile apps, CTV/OTT, programmatic partners, and social platforms. The role ensures that all inventory is correctly set up, monetized efficiently, compliant with platform and policy requirements, and continuously optimized to maximize yield and revenue stability. This position focuses on day-to-day delivery, performance monitoring, issue resolution, and reporting, translating monetization strategy into consistent operational results. Success in the role will be measured through clearly defined quarterly KPIs covering revenue performance, fill rate, yield improvement, monetization uptime, and reporting accuracy. The following job description details the skills and competencies required for this level. SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS 4+ years in ad ops, programmatic advertising, or digital monetization (agency, ad-tech, or publisher side). Strong knowledge of GAM, SSPs, DSPs (DV360, The Trade Desk). Familiar with paid media platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads. Experience managing ad-tech partners (Teads, Magnite, PubMatic, SpringServe, etc.). Strong analytical and reporting skills (Google Analytics, Looker, Data Studio). Background in CTV/FAST advertising models is a strong plus. Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset and High attention to detail   Excellent communication skills with the Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment   Proactive and ownership-driven attitude with Strong time management and prioritization skills Commercial mindset: ability to translate ad ops into revenue opportunities for sales. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 1.Display & Video (Web)  Manage and hands on GAM trafficking and line item setup to ensure accurate and timely campaign implementation. Support and hands on Prebid setup and troubleshoot related issues to maintain optimal header bidding performance. Apply and optimize floor prices by geo, device, and format to maximize revenue opportunities. Conduct creative QA and ensure compliance with internal policies and industry standards. Perform daily pacing and delivery checks and adjust campaigns as needed to meet performance goals. 2.App (iOS / Android) Validate SDK integrations in collaboration with the tech team to ensure proper ad delivery. Map ad units according to placements to ensure correct implementation and tracking. Maintain mediation waterfall hygiene to optimize demand competition and yield. Monitor latency and timeout settings to improve performance and user experience. Conduct regular app monetization stability checks to ensure consistent revenue performance. 3.CTV / OTT / FAST Configure and manage ad pods to ensure proper ad sequencing and delivery. Validate and monitor SSAI integrations to maintain seamless ad insertion. Support deal setup, including PMPs and Programmatic Guaranteed campaigns. Monitor delivery, pacing, and fill rates to ensure campaign effectiveness. Perform quality control checks to maintain strong CTV monetization performance. 4.Programmatic Partners (SSPs, DSP Tags)  Execute partner onboarding processes to enable smooth integrations. Monitor and hands on daily performance and yield across partners to optimize revenue. Block MFA and low-quality demand sources to protect inventory quality. Enforce floor price compliance across all programmatic partners. Prepare and share partner performance reports with relevant stakeholders. 5.Social Media Monetization  Enable and manage monetization across all social media platforms and accounts. Ensure policy compliance and verify monetization eligibility requirements. Optimize yield across formats and geographies to maximize revenue. Track revenue and reconcile payouts to ensure accuracy. Prepare social monetization reports and escalate issues when necessary. 6.Revenue & KPIs and Success Metrics: Maintain monthly revenue variance within ±5% of forecasted targets Monitor revenue trends and proactively address fluctuations Collaborate with commercial teams to stabilize and grow revenue performance What We Offer The chance to define the digital monetization roadmap for Lovin & Smashi. Hands-on exposure to CTV & FAST monetization, one of the fastest-growing areas in media. A cross-functional role bridging tech, content, and commercial. Growth opportunities within a leading regional media company. Augustus Overview Augustus is a Middle Eastern digital media holding company based in Dubai, Cairo and Riyadh and has been designed to adapt and evolve to this perpetually changing media environment.  We apply our expertise to building media brands, each centered on an audience first mindset, such as promoting the ideals of a positive lifestyle or an aspirational business mentality. Our brands have originated from new media platforms and power our entire ecosystem of services, especially creating brand communications that resonate with our audiences across digital and the real world. Our content is loved and seen by millions, natively across visual, audio and text platforms.  Lovin’  Lovin’ is a local news and lifestyle brand. Lovin’ captures the best of the world around us: what we see, do, think, eat and drink. Lovin’ presents a positive view of our city, town, country or community. Lovin’s mantra is simple: Lovin’ Your Life.  Smashi Smashi is a business news network streaming live from the heart of the Arab world, covering the most innovative products, services and technologies changing our lives. Smashi is a mindset, it’s for the driven, the dreamers and the doers.  ODEUM  ODEUM is our in-house content studio, powered by data and insights, designed to produce new media formats, in real time for clients that live across our brand channels. We connect brands with communities and culture.

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Fulfillment Systems
review_candidates.description: Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection. Reports to: Director of Engineering Location: Remote (Costa Rica)/ Remote (United States)/ Remote (India) About The Role Backcountry is looking for a senior engineer to own the architecture and evolution of the ecommerce fulfillment systems that power how orders move from click to doorstep. As Senior Software Engineer, Ecommerce Fulfillment , you will drive hands-on development across order management and warehouse management systems while leveraging AI toolsets to raise engineering throughput and quality across the team. Within your first 6–12 months, you will have delivered measurable improvements to system scalability and reliability, reduced technical debt in legacy components, and established patterns for AI-accelerated development that other teams adopt. This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility. What You'll Do Drive architecture design, hands-on development, testing, deployment, and production support for ecommerce fulfillment systems including order management and warehouse management. Leverage AI toolsets to improve engineering delivery throughput, quality, and reliability. Share and evolve AI capabilities with other developers and teams, raising the bar for AI use across the organization. Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to deliver scalable, user-focused features that elevate business value. Champion modern engineering practices including clean architecture, unit testing, automation, performance optimization, and observability. Break down large projects into manageable delivery chunks, clearly communicating status, roadblocks, and dependencies across teams. Influence architectural direction and propose improvements that enhance system performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Produce high-quality documentation including TRDs, diagrams, technical instructions, and onboarding materials. Improve reliability monitoring, alerting, and incident response for mission-critical systems. Identify opportunities to simplify legacy components, reduce technical debt, and deliver long-term efficiency gains. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field 10+ years of professional software development experience with a strong ecommerce background Hands-on experience leveraging AI toolsets for productivity and development acceleration Expertise with Java and Spring Boot Familiarity with order management and warehouse management systems Deep expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, and design patterns including pub/sub and event-driven architecture Proficiency in at least one core backend language such as Java, Python, or C# Strong understanding of relational databases and SQL Hands-on skill with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines Experience with AWS or GCP and cloud-first architecture Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills Strong problem-solving ability and the capacity to think creatively and strategically Why Join The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work. Cross-Functional Impact: Your work touches order management, warehouse systems, and the broader engineering organization. You will influence architectural decisions and partner directly with cross-functional leadership to solve real fulfillment challenges. AI-First Skill Building: Get hands-on with advanced AI tools driving complex agentic workflow and toolset development that brings real value to both the engineering department and customers. End-to-End Ownership: Own architecture, delivery, and production reliability for mission-critical fulfillment systems. You will identify problems, propose solutions, and ship them. Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands. Competitive Benefits (Costa Rica): We offer an attractive benefits package including primarily remote work, private medical and life insurance, additional paid time off, monthly allowances and reimbursements, employee discounts, and opportunities for professional growth. Interview Process Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for. Hiring Manager Interview - A deeper conversation focused on your architecture experience, ecommerce fulfillment domain knowledge, and approach to AI-accelerated development. Technical Discussion - A hands-on review of system design, distributed architecture patterns, and problem-solving approach with members of the engineering team. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our [office location]. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate. Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
